summary: Stronger human+agent branch/path ownership etiquette (#651): durable .agentic/collab ownership claims, path/branch pause gestures, worktree isolation + concurrent-edit checks wired into collab_policy_check, feed signals, MCP plate_collab_ownership_* / etiquette / concurrent + gh plate collab --claim|--release|--etiquette.
migration_impact: Optional local ownership registry under .agentic/collab/ (gitignored). Humans claim path/branch pauses; agents must pass paths/branch into plate_collab_check. No required config change.
migration_guidance: 2. To pause agents on a path: gh plate collab --claim --kind path --target <path> (or plate_collab_ownership_claim).
3. Agents: include --paths / paths= and --branch in collab checks before edit/push; respect blocked claims.
4. Release when done: gh plate collab --release <claim-id> or --kind/--target.
agent_notes: First enforceable slice of #651 on top of #643 driver labels. Does not replace CODEOWNERS/branch protection. Prefer feature/*|bug/* branches in isolated worktrees. Issue may remain open for richer GitHub-native ownership signals.
